TRUSTED STARTING POINTS

Useful links.
Not guesswork.

Business rules, platform features and funding programmes can change. Use these official sources to verify details before making decisions.

Important

These are reference links, not confirmation that your business qualifies for any funding, licence, Google listing or programme. Check the current requirements directly.

Business networks

Bahamas Chamber of Commerce and Employers’ Confederation

Official business events, networking, advocacy and membership information.

www.thebahamaschamber.com
Toastmasters — Find a Club

Find a local or online club to practice pitches, speaking and leadership. Not a funding programme.

www.toastmasters.org

Online visibility

Google Search Central — SEO Starter Guide

Official technical and content basics for discoverable websites.

developers.google.com
Google Ads — Campaign types

Compare search, video and other ad types for business goals.

support.google.com
Google Business Profile eligibility

Confirm that your business qualifies before creating a listing.

support.google.com
Google Business Profile representation rules

Official policies for names, addresses, categories and customer-facing details.

support.google.com
Meta Business Help Center

Official help for Facebook, Instagram and Meta business features.

www.facebook.com
LinkedIn Help

Official setup and management guidance for professional profiles and Pages.

www.linkedin.com

Registration & compliance

Bahamas Department of Inland Revenue

Official business licence rules, application guidance and updates.

inlandrevenue.finance.gov.bs
National Insurance Board — Employers

Employer registration guidance and contribution information.

www.nib-bahamas.com
National Insurance Board — Online Portals

Official online services, including Employer Self Service.

www.nib-bahamas.com

Funding & support

Small Business Development Centre Bahamas

Business mentoring, training and access-to-capital programmes. Check current criteria.

sbdcbahamas.com
